prompt:

Asset type: TALKPIK AI temporary auth pause page concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for rate-limited auth error state only.
Primary request: Redesign 33-X-11-auth-error/rate-limited.
Direction: temporary pause with clear next time.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Show a centered Snow card on Mist canvas with TALKPIK AI mark, title explaining too many requests, muted helper copy, prominent countdown in minutes/seconds, disabled retry button, secondary login and home links. Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Result/Statistic Countdown/Button/Card UI.
Color palette: neutral Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; disabled action is Fog/Steel; enabled primary would be Obsidian #09090b.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, compact density, no letter spacing.
Constraints: rate-limit state signal must be unmistakable; safe non-blaming wording; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, danger-red dominant styling, gradients, chromatic CTA, provider/raw error codes, technical stack references, watermark.
